## Template

A worker sees nothing of this chat. Send the brief in this shape:
Goal: what must be true when the worker is done
Files: the paths to read or change, and what each holds
Constraints: what must not change, versions, limits
Check: how the worker proves it is done

## Code

the brief carries code ({lines} from line {line}). A brief describes the job; the worker writes the code. Say what the file must do and how to check it, not its contents.
